answers.reason: The president chairs the university's central bodies, which includes the senate.
The description does not explicitly grant the president a seat in the budget planning round.
The description does not mention the president participating in appointment committees.
The president leads the university rather than individual faculties and is not a member of the faculty council.
The study commission is a faculty-level body and the president is not listed as a member.
The examination board operates at the faculty level without the president's direct involvement.
The internal research funding round is a faculty-level matter.
Module revision working groups operate within degree programmes without the president.
Laboratory equipment procurement is handled at the faculty or department level.
Orientation week planning is an activity outside the president's central administrative duties.
